s1533: This page explains the tide calculation step by step, using the methods applied in the field and in training scenarios. The aim is to find the tidal height at the required time from the HW/LW time-height data, then add it to the charted depth to assess the safe depth.
s1534: The standard approach is to divide the HW-LW interval into 6 equal hours and use the hourly rise/fall percentage from the “Rule of Twelfths”. Alternatively, on a tidal curve you can join the LW and HW points, draw the tidal height line and read the height at the required time off the graph.
